title: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B | TechCrunch
summary: Voice AI startup ElevenLabs announced today that it’s allowing employees to cash out a portion of their vested equity at a $22 billion valuation, doubling the $11 billion valuation the company hit when it raised $500 million in February.
